tagline: Leading producer of specialty and intermediate chemicals for consumer, industrial and other applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Surfactants represent 71% of the company's consolidated net sales in 2025, constituting the dominant segment of the company's operations

kpis.name: Surfactants Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of surfactants, the primary business segment
kpis.description: Surfactants are chemical agents that affect the interaction between two surfaces. They represent 71% of consolidated net sales in 2025 and are used in detergents, shampoos, body washes, and industrial applications.

kpis.name: Polymers Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of polymers, the second-largest business segment
kpis.description: Polymers include polyurethane polyols, polyester resins, and phthalic anhydride. They represent 25% of consolidated net sales in 2025 and are used in rigid foams, coatings, adhesives, and elastomers.

kpis.name: Specialty Products Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of specialty products in food and pharmaceutical applications
kpis.description: Specialty products include flavors, emulsifiers, and solubilizers used in food, flavor, nutritional supplement, and pharmaceutical applications. They represent 4% of consolidated net sales in 2025.

kpis.name: Cybersecurity Governance
kpis.explanation: Framework for oversight and management of cybersecurity risks overseen by the Audit Committee
kpis.description: The Audit Committee oversees cybersecurity risk management with quarterly reporting. The Chief Information Officer, with over 25 years of experience and ITIL Service Master certification, leads a team of cybersecurity specialists. The Senior Manager in cybersecurity has over 15 years of experience and multiple industry certifications.

kpis.name: Asset Footprint Optimization
kpis.explanation: Strategic efforts to streamline the portfolio of production sites
kpis.description: In the fourth quarter of 2025, the company completed the sale of its manufacturing assets in the Philippines (SPQI in Bauan, Batangas) to Masurf, Inc., with a tolling agreement to ensure customer continuity in Southeast Asia. It also closed the sale of its Lake Providence assets in Louisiana, reflecting its ongoing portfolio optimization and focus on key growth opportunities.

risks.title: Environmental remediation at Maywood
risks.score_rationale: The Maywood site has been listed on the National Priorities List since 1993 and is subject to a consent decree signed in February 2024. The language indicates uncertain future costs and potential material liability beyond current provisions, with a potential existential impact. The Litigation category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Environmental penalties at Millsdale
risks.score_rationale: On March 26, 2024, the USEPA issued a notice of violation for non-compliance with air emission regulations at the Millsdale plant. Although penalties are not quantified, the risk of financial or operational sanctions is high. Central placement in the 10-K and concerning language.

risks.title: Chemical contamination at Elwood and Fieldsboro
risks.score_rationale: Contamination above regulatory thresholds was discovered at two production sites. Obligation for self-managed remediation. The text states that actual costs could materially differ from provisions, indicating significant financial risk. Environmental category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Tax rescission lawsuit in Brazil
risks.score_rationale: A rescission lawsuit was filed in 2023 by the Brazilian Treasury seeking to cancel PIS/COFINS tax credits. Recent court decisions (2024) have clarified the statute of limitations, but the risk of material financial loss persists. Cautious language and notable placement in the report.

risks.title: Environmental liability at Wilmington
risks.score_rationale: The Wilmington, MA site has been on the National Priorities List since 2006. A 2023 consent decree mandates remediation actions. The payment obligation is unlimited (5% of costs with no cap). Mention of potential natural resource damages in 2022. Concerning language and open financial risk.

risks.title: Cyber threats and IT system security
risks.score_rationale: The Audit Committee oversees cybersecurity with quarterly reporting. The team is experienced and certified, but no major breaches are reported. The risk is well-managed, but reliance on IT systems in the chemical industry makes this risk significant. Cybersecurity category moderately weighted.

risks.title: FIFRA non-compliance on biocides
risks.score_rationale: A pre-enforcement notice of FIFRA violation was received in March 2025, with a $1.1M penalty paid. Although resolved, this reveals a regulatory vulnerability in biocide distribution. The risk is mitigated by partial recovery ($1M), but the precedent is significant.

ai_positioning.summary: SCL does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing.
